metadata.case_name: RAI NARAYAN PARSHAD v. CHIT HING CONSTRUCTION ENGINEERING AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: general labourer on construction sites (construction site worker)
plaintiff.occupation_after: cleaner in a garment shop (employed by ISS Facility Service Ltd since November 2010)
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: simple manual tasks such as messenger, delivery worker, caretakers, car park attendants
plaintiff.education_level: Hong Kong equivalent of Form 1 or 2

source: CT scan showed left frontal epidural haematoma, bilateral parietal brain contusions and small left pneumothorax.
CT scan showed left frontal epidural haematoma, bilateral parietal brain contusions and small left pneumothorax.
X-ray showed fractures in the left clavicle and right superior public ramus;

injuries.description: fracture in the right superior public ramus
source: X-ray showed fractures in the left clavicle and right superior public ramus;
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of pubis without disruption of pelvic ring

source: CT scan showed left frontal epidural haematoma, bilateral parietal brain contusions and small left pneumothorax.
The plaintiff suffered from bilateral trochlear nerve paresis as a result of his head injury.

injuries.description: Laceration at the left frontal scalp and bruises at the left parietal scalp, left ear, left side of the neck, left arm and both lower limbs
injuries.body_part: left frontal scalp; left parietal scalp; left ear; left side of the neck; left arm; both lower limbs
source: Laceration at the left frontal scalp and bruises at the left parietal scalp, left ear, left side of the neck, left arm and both lower limbs;
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: Skin abrasions at the left shoulder and left half of the trunk
injuries.body_part: left shoulder; left half of the trunk
source: Skin abrasions at the left shoulder and left half of the trunk;

injuries.description: mild post-concussional syndrome (residual headache, non-specific dizziness, subjectively impaired memory)
source: As a result of the head injury, the plaintiff had residual headache, non-specific dizziness and subjectively impaired memory, akin to the diagnosis of a mild post-concussional syndrome.

injuries.description: residual esophoria with left hyperphoria in primary gaze
source: the plaintiff’s binocular diplopia had slightly improved with time but there was still residual esophoria with left hyperphoria in primary gaze.

manifestations.description: diplopia on downgaze (vertical binocular diplopia, worse on looking down)
subjectively impaired memory (may forget where he had placed his belongings; may lose train of thoughts)
numbness of the left half of the body / partial nociceptive and proprioceptive loss on the entire left half of the body
full limb power (no focal motor deficits noted on follow-up examinations)
difficulty walking down staircases (needs to close one eye to reduce diplopia)
wearing prismatic glasses to alleviate binocular diplopia

treatments_received: insertion of EVD for intracranial pressure monitoring
transfer to Tung Wah Eastern Hospital for rehabilitation and physiotherapy
physiotherapy at Ruttonjee and Tang Shiu Kin Hospital
follow-up visits at Orthopaedic Clinic and Department of Neurology (Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital) and Department of Ophthalmology (Tung Wah Eastern Hospital)

losses.description: Unable to return to his pre-incident job as a general labourer at construction sites; more suited for simple manual tasks such as caretakers, car park attendants, messengers and delivery worker.
